title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. translated_title: Jev-ToM：在类型化决策模型中评估心智理论
translated_abstract: 对话与协作助手需要反复判断伙伴知道什么、相信什么或意图做什么。对于受限的心智理论选择而言，类型化决策模型为生成式大语言模型提供了一种潜在的替代方案。我们提出了 Jev-ToM，在来自九个心智理论基准、涵盖六种能力组的 11,117 个英文文本问题上，比较了五种类型化决策模型与七个生成式基线模型。在包含原生对照组的情况下，TypeSafe Jev 达到了 73.2% 的源平衡准确率，并在全部六种能力中排名第一或第二，在信念、目标/欲望/意图以及情绪方面处于领先地位。其他类型化模型在不同任务中也展现出各自的优势。独立的资源比较表明，Jev 有望降低重复进行心智理论选择的成本和等待时间。基于置信度的选择仍然依赖于具体基准，而所提供的原因（依据其关联方式）既可能修复错误，也可能推翻原本正确的答案。候选扩展揭示了……
tldr: 该论文提出 Jev-ToM 评测框架，在九个心智理论基准上比较类型化决策模型与生成式大语言模型，发现 TypeSafe Jev 以 73.2% 的平衡准确率在六种能力中名列前茅，并有望以更低的成本和等待时间完成受限的心智理论选择，成为大模型之外的可行替代方案。
en_tdlr: Jev-ToM benchmarks five typed decision models against seven generative baselines across nine Theory of Mind benchmarks, showing that TypeSafe Jev ranks first or second across all six capability groups with 73.2% balanced accuracy while potentially reducing the cost and latency of repeated ToM selection, offering a viable alternative to large language models for bounded Theory of Mind reasoning.
